summary: dlab_workshop exfiltrates process.env and host identity to Burp Collaborator host on require()
details: On module load, the package collects process.env, os.userInfo(), process.cwd(), and process.argv and POSTs the JSON body to a hardcoded Burp Collaborator subdomain at 9eojg3y52itd6161v4lhojajrax1lw9l.oastify.com. The exfiltrated environment typically contains AWS, GitHub, npm, and CI credentials belonging to the installer. The destination is an out-of-band interaction host controlled by whoever generated the Collaborator subdomain, not by the installer, and the transmission fires as a top-level side effect the moment the module is required.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
